HELLO, WE’RE PURPLE FOX

Thoughtful by nature.
Creative at heart.

At Purple Fox Event Planners, our approach begins with listening. To the traditions that matter to you. The colours you return to. The atmosphere you want your guests to remember.

We see event design as a conversation between those personal details and the space around them. Flowers, fabrics, lighting and layout become a way to tell your story.

Whether you are planning a wedding, a birthday or an intimate gathering, our aim is to help you find a direction that feels considered, welcoming and unmistakably yours.

Let’s talk about your occasion↗

WHAT BEAUTIFUL MEANS TO US

Beautiful is a room that feels welcoming.
A detail that means something.
A celebration that feels like you.

BEHIND THE BEAUTIFUL

From a spark of an idea
to a considered concept.

These AI-created images illustrate a design process; they are not photographs of our team.

01 / THE STARTING POINT

Find the feeling

A reference, a colour or a favourite memory helps us understand your taste. We discuss the mood before moving into individual decorative details.

02 / THE CREATIVE DETAILS

Bring it together

Florals, fabrics and shapes should work in conversation. We explore how the pieces can complement one another and suit the venue.

03 / THE HUMAN TOUCH

Think about the experience

A beautiful room should also feel comfortable. We discuss the welcome, the seating and the movement of your guests through the day.
